resources.string: A Monero address, a monero: code, or a DUCAT card
A payment to a contact carries a note and lands in your chat. An address does not.
That does not look like a Monero address.
What you are asking %1$s for. Your balance and the network fee are theirs to worry about, not yours — this is a message, not a transaction.
That is more than you can send once the fee is counted.
Uses %1$d note(s) · usually confirmed in about %2$d minutes
The fee is an estimate until the transaction is built; the exact one is shown after sending.
%1$s has not shared an address, so you can ask but not send yet. Switch to Request — it carries one back.
They have not shared an address. Ask them to send a request, or to turn on \"let contacts pay me directly\".
Plus about %1$s in fees — %2$s in total.
Monero payments cannot be reversed or cancelled. Check the address — there is nobody to appeal to if it is wrong.
The fee could not be estimated just now. The transaction pays whatever it costs when it is built.
